headline: Second Dušičky pass on 1 Nov: 340 churches checked against today's parish announcements. 40 were wrong for 2 Nov, and 37 of them are fixed and live in three batches. The first batch went live at about 09:10 CET. Both feast-page rules hold live, so the pages weren't changed.

shipped.title: Dušičky 2026 second pass, batch 1: 26 sourced corrections for 2 Nov
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-01 ~08:12 UTC at 390 px. /dusicky/olomouc/ shows the cathedral 07:00 'mimořádná', sv. Mořic 16:00 and Nové Sady 17:15 on 2 Nov. /kostel/70001386081579/ (Olomouc cathedral) shows 'zítra' 07:00 and 18:00 'pontifikální, celebruje arcibiskup'. /dusicky/karvina/ shows Fryštát 08:00 polsky and 18:00.

shipped.title: Dušičky 2026 second pass, batch 2: 2 sourced corrections for 2 Nov (Praha sv. Jakub, Liberec sv. Antonín)
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-01 ~08:17 UTC at 390 px. /dusicky/praha/ and /kostel/100027/ show 2 Nov 18:00 'Mozartovo Requiem' with the latinsky chip next to the 06:45 in kaple sv. Anny.

shipped.title: Dušičky 2026 second pass, batch 3: 9 sourced corrections for 2 Nov (Břevnov, Plzeň Domeček, Písek, Zlámanka, Nový Jičín, Havlíčkův Brod, Chrudim)
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-01 ~08:26 UTC at 390 px. /dusicky/havlickuv-brod/ shows 2 Nov with only 18:00 at sv. Vojtěch ('po ní dušičková pobožnost na hřbitově'). NPM's weekly 18:00 is gone from 2 Nov.

notes: Clock note: the container clock and the Pages server's Date header agreed (start 07:52 UTC, batch 1 merged ~08:10 UTC, so about 09:10 CET). GitHub's check-run timestamps read about an hour later. The three merges are bb62806, 8a5046c and c606245 on main.

Scope: 291 churches from the 28 Oct sample (all 209 marked unverifiable, plus the 82 confirmed for 1 Nov only), the 8 leads from 28 Oct, and 45 churches in the 12 largest towns outside the sample. sv. Vojtěch in Havlíčkův Brod was added because a checked parish's notice moved a Mass there. Unit = a church. The 9th lead, Olomouc-Nové Sady, was settled in the sample (fixed: 17:15).

28 Oct sample: 84 confirmed, 31 wrong, 30 fixed, 176 still unverifiable. Of the 209 priority-1 churches, 39 now have a 2026 source (25 confirmed, 14 wrong). Of the 82 priority-2 churches, 18 had wrong 2 Nov times; most were a Dušičky Mass the registry lacks (Olomouc cathedral, Svatý Kopeček, Hodolany, Poruba, Svinov, Karviná-Fryštát, Jablonec, Liberec sv. Antonín and others).

Outside the sample (Písek, Trutnov, Kroměříž, Uherské Hradiště, Český Těšín, Litoměřice, Nový Jičín, Chrudim, Havlíčkův Brod, Krnov, Strakonice, Klatovy): 10 confirmed, 7 wrong, 7 fixed (counting sv. Vojtěch), 28 still unverifiable. The repo has no population data, so I took the order from my own knowledge of Czech town sizes.

Wrong but not fixed (3): Plzeň Greek-Catholic sv. Mikuláš and Praha-Spořilov differ only on the morning of 1 Nov, which was over before a fix could ship. Strakonice sv. Václav 16:30 on 2 Nov is held because the reviewer hit a bot wall (HTTP 466) and couldn't confirm the source.

Held back and counted as unverifiable, because the source didn't meet the 28 Oct rule. Praha-Podolí 15:00: farnostbranik.cz showed the reviewer a firewall page, and the quote's punctuation is loose. Třebíč Horka-Domky: the sheet says only 'Hřbitov'. Brno-Slatina: the schedule has no year. Klatovy 17:00: the PDF says only 'KLATOVY'. Kvasice: 'hřbitovní kostel' could be either church.

Fixes: data/corrections.json, 37 new entries checked 2026-11-01 (106 in total). Each has church id, date, add or drop, source URL, source date, a verbatim quote and the check date. node data/corrections.mjs applied them. data/corrections.test.mjs proved they land, locally and in CI on each PR. Data only; no code changed.

Review: each batch had an independent subagent re-fetch every source and check the 2026 date, the quote, the church, the time and add/drop. Batch 1: 26/26 OK. Batch 2: Podolí blocked, removed. Batch 3: Strakonice unreachable, removed. Images (posters, JPG ohlášky) were read by eye.
Kladno-Kročehlavy drop of 08:05 on 2 Nov is a no-op: the registry row is for the 3rd Monday and already carried 'kromě 2. 11. 2026'. I kept it as a record of the source.

Bot walls, unchanged, and I didn't work around any of them. Cloudflare or 403: Lhotka, Hostivař, Kbely, Stodůlky, Hloubětín; all five Zlín parishes; Brno-Komín and Žabovřesky; ČB děkanství, sv. Jan Nepomucký and Suché Vrbné; HK Pražské Předměstí; Příbram; Cheb; Havířov; Frýdek; Ostrava-Přívoz; Moravská Ostrava (WEDOS 401); Greek-Catholic KV; Kroměříž, Uherské Hradiště, Český Těšín (farnosttesin.cz, agendafarnosti.cz), both Trutnov sites; Strakonice (466). About 50 of the sample's unverifiable rows are walls, not missing notices.

Parishes with nothing for 2026 yet: Opava minorites and the Panny Marie parish (konkatedrála, sv. Vojtěch, sv. Kříž); Krnov, whose newest ohlášky are for 11.–18. 10.; Henčlov (schedule ends 1 Nov); Louky nad Olší; Děčín I (undated standing schedule says Monday 7:00, the site says 07:30). In Praha, 56 sample churches are still unverifiable.

Registry problems seen, not changed. Kylešovice (Opava): weekday Masses are suspended 18 Oct–22 Nov (priest's surgery). Sněženka (Olomouc): 1 Nov 10:00 row looks stale. Hodkovičky shows its once-a-year pilgrimage 9:30 on 1 Nov. Praha sv. Duch 9:30 has a stale summer-only note. Jihlava sv. Ignác's Greek-Catholic 10:00 is listed twice. Plzeň Greek-Catholic Sundays are 9:30/11:00 all November, and Wednesdays 18:00 (registry 9:00/10:30, 18:30). Plzeň NPM's first-Monday note 'bohoslužba slova' is wrong for 2 Nov: it's a Mass, and the Liturgy of the Word moved to 9 Nov. Spořilov's Sunday 08:30 is missing. Kolín: the parish says the Monday morning Mass is at sv. Bartoloměj, the site has it at Nejsv. Trojice. New parish sites missing from the registry: farnost-svatahora.cz (svata-hora.cz is a rental site now), farnost-teplice.cz. Liberec arciděkanství works over https; only http is walled.
Per-church results with source and note: docs/review/2026-11-01-dusicky-check.json.

feast_pages.changes: None needed. Live /dusicky/, /dusicky/praha/ and /dusicky/jihlava/ load no app bundle: no module script and no /assets/*.js. The only script is the inline page_view beacon (static:true), plus one stylesheet and the manifest link. Dated rows: in 6 live town pages (Praha, Brno, Ostrava, Jihlava, Opava, Znojmo), 445 of 478 rows belong to churches whose registry date is older than 18 months (before 2025-05-01), and every one carries 'rozpis ověřen naposledy D. M. YYYY, ověřte u farnosti'. No fresh church has the date. 0 mismatches. Code: isStale (src/domain/registry.ts) used by feastCityPage (src/domain/feast.ts), covered by feast.test.ts 'lists a church whose schedule is older than 18 months with its date on the row'.

decisions.question: Which file is the 28 Oct data_check? The brief names docs/review/2026-10-28.json, which doesn't exist.
options: docs/review/2026-10-29.json (data_check of the 28 Oct check, run overnight 28/29 Oct)
decisions.why: It is the only file with a data_check block. Its counts (395 checked, 209 unverifiable, 30 towns, 9 leads) match the brief.

decisions.question: 1 Nov corrections on the day itself?
decisions.why: A fix to a morning Mass would go live after it. The 1 Nov morning differences found (Plzeň Greek-Catholic, Spořilov) are in the notes.

decisions.question: A correction whose source the independent reviewer couldn't reach (bot wall), though the first checker read it
decisions.why: The merge rule asks for a review of the sources against the entries. Re-adding is a one-line data change if Pavol wants the looser rule.

decisions.question: Source that gives the time but doesn't name the church
options: infer the church from context (other church named separately, standing rota)
need the church named or the parish to have one church
decisions.default_taken: need it named (Horka-Domky, Klatovy, Kvasice held). Břevnov went in once the parish's own calendar gave the basilica's address for the 16:00 Mass
decisions.why: Same rule as 28 Oct. A wrong place is worse than a missing row.

decisions.question: Plzeň Domeček: drop the stale 17:30 only, or also add the November rota's 18:00?
decisions.why: 17:30 is wrong on every source. The parish's special 2 Nov list doesn't name Domeček, and that evening's 18:00 is announced at Všech svatých (Roudná).

decisions.question: Merge with the android CI job still running?
options: merge on the gate (typecheck · test · build = the test job)
decisions.default_taken: merge on the gate for #79 and #80; #81 had all jobs green
decisions.why: AGENTS.md: 'Block only on these.' The diff is data only, so the Android shell is untouched.

decisions.question: sv. Jakub's Latin Mass: language in the note or in the lang field?
decisions.why: The page shows lang as a chip. With both, it would say latinsky twice.

decisions.question: node_modules is committed as a symlink to itself; npm ci replaces it locally
options: leave it, mark it assume-unchanged locally
decisions.why: It is outside this data pass. See proposals.

proposals.name: The 'kromě 2. 11. 2026' text shows on other days' rows
options: leave it until the next registry refresh drops it
hide 'kromě <date>' parts of the note on the feast pages and in the day list when the row is shown for a different date
show it only on the church's weekly ordo
proposals.recommendation: Hide it outside the weekly ordo. On /dusicky/havlickuv-brod/ the 1 Nov 18:00 row reads 'mše svatá · kromě 2. 11. 2026', which is true but noise on that day. It's a small change in detail() or parseNote's display, and the wording is yours to approve.

proposals.name: Re-check tonight or early on 2 Nov
options: one more pass at about 18:00 on 1 Nov over the 204 still unverifiable, for parishes that post ohlášky after the evening Mass
a browser pass for the ~25 bot-walled sites
proposals.recommendation: One evening pass over the 30 largest towns' unverifiable churches. Several checkers saw parishes with nothing posted yet this morning. It's cheap, and fixes still land before Monday's first Masses.

proposals.name: Registry data-quality list for ČBK
options: add the registry problems in data_check.notes to the ČBK data-quality list (Kylešovice, Sněženka, Plzeň Greek-Catholic, Plzeň NPM note, Spořilov, Kolín, Děčín, new parish URLs)
proposals.recommendation: Add them to the list. Sending it is outreach, so that part is yours.

proposals.name: Remove the tracked node_modules symlink
options: git rm --cached node_modules (it is in .gitignore already)
proposals.recommendation: Remove it in a one-line chore PR. Every fresh session's npm ci shows it as deleted, and the stop hook then nags.

next: Pavol: open /dusicky/praha/ and /dusicky/olomouc/ on your phone. The read-back was 390 px emulation.
No TestFlight or store build was dispatched (brief). The corrections reach installed apps through the data shards and service worker, with no new build.
The 3 Nov rebuild: corrections dated 1 and 2 Nov are skipped after their date, and the 'kromě 2. 11. 2026' notes stay in the shards until the next registry refresh (data/extract.mjs).
Next towns by population outside the sample, not yet checked: Kopřivnice, Bohumín, Žďár nad Sázavou, Vyškov, Kutná Hora, Jirkov, Žatec, Brandýs n. L.-St. Boleslav, Náchod, Mělník, Louny, Kralupy.
Domeček 18:00 and Strakonice 16:30 can be added in one line each if Pavol accepts the looser readings above.
